passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
The choirmaster led music in worship.
David wanted this psalm sung in worship.

passages.text: O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm for the choirmaster.
The LORD is the subject.
The LORD has searched me.
The LORD knows me.
passages.original: לַ֭מְנַצֵּחַ לְדָוִ֣ד מִזְמ֑וֹר יְהוָ֥ה חֲ֝קַרְתַּ֗נִי וַתֵּדָֽע׃

passages.text: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the subject of this psalm.
The LORD knows me.
The LORD knows when I sit.
The LORD knows when I rise.
The LORD understands my thoughts.
The LORD understands my thoughts even from far away.
passages.original: אַתָּ֣ה יָ֭דַעְתָּ שִׁבְתִּ֣י וְקוּמִ֑י בַּ֥נְתָּה לְ֝רֵעִ֗י מֵרָחֽוֹק׃

passages.text: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
passages.sermon:
The LORD knows David.
The LORD searches David’s path.
The LORD searches where David lies down.
The LORD understands all of David’s ways.
passages.original: אָרְחִ֣י וְרִבְעִ֣י זֵרִ֑יתָ וְֽכָל־ דְּרָכַ֥י הִסְכַּֽנְתָּה׃

passages.text: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD knows everything about me.
He knows every word I will speak.
He knows my words before I say them.
He understands my thoughts completely.
Nothing I say is hidden from Him.
passages.original: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ין מִ֭לָּה בִּלְשׁוֹנִ֑י הֵ֥ן יְ֝הוָ֗ה יָדַ֥עְתָּ כֻלָּֽהּ׃

passages.text: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
passages.sermon:
God knows everything about me.
God surrounds me on every side.
God is behind me.
God is before me.
God places His hand on me.
passages.original: אָח֣וֹר וָקֶ֣דֶם צַרְתָּ֑נִי וַתָּ֖שֶׁת עָלַ֣י כַּפֶּֽכָה׃

passages.text: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
passages.sermon:
God knows everything about me.
God understands my words before I speak them.
God surrounds me on every side.
God places His hand upon me.
This knowledge amazes me.
This knowledge is too great for me.
I cannot reach it.
I cannot fully understand it.
passages.original: פִּלְאִיָּה דַ֣עַת מִמֶּ֑נִּי נִ֝שְׂגְּבָ֗ה לֹא־ א֥וּכַֽל לָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
passages.sermon:
God is present everywhere.
God’s Spirit is always with me.
I cannot escape from God’s Spirit.
I cannot run away from God’s presence.
passages.original: אָ֭נָ֥ה אֵלֵ֣ךְ מֵרוּחֶ֑ךָ וְ֝אָ֗נָה מִפָּנֶ֥יךָ אֶבְרָֽח׃

passages.text: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
passages.sermon: God is present everywhere.\r\nIf I go up to the heavens, God is there.\r\nIf I lie down in Sheol, God is there.
passages.original: אִם־ אֶסַּ֣ק שָׁ֭מַיִם שָׁ֣ם אָ֑תָּה וְאַצִּ֖יעָה שְּׁא֣וֹל הִנֶּֽךָּ׃

passages.text: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea, even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
passages.sermon:
God is everywhere.
God is always present.
If I rise on the wings of the dawn, You are there.
If I settle by the farthest sea, You are there.
Even there, Your hand will guide me.
Your right hand will hold me fast.
passages.original: אֶשָּׂ֥א כַנְפֵי־ שָׁ֑חַר אֶ֝שְׁכְּנָ֗ה בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית יָֽם׃ גַּם־ שָׁ֭ם יָדְךָ֣ תַנְחֵ֑נִי וְֽתֹאחֲזֵ֥נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”— even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
passages.sermon:
God sees everything.
God is never limited by darkness.
If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me,” I am wrong.
If I think the light will become night around me, I am mistaken.
Even darkness is not dark to God.
Night shines like the day to God.
For God, darkness is as bright as light.
passages.original: וָ֭אֹמַר אַךְ־ חֹ֣שֶׁךְ יְשׁוּפֵ֑נִי וְ֝לַ֗יְלָה א֣וֹר בַּעֲדֵֽנִי׃ גַּם־ חֹשֶׁךְ֮ לֹֽא־ יַחְשִׁ֪יךְ מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָ וְ֭לַיְלָה כַּיּ֣וֹם יָאִ֑יר כַּ֝חֲשֵׁיכָ֗ה כָּאוֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
passages.sermon:
God formed my inmost being.
God created my deepest parts.
God knit me together in my mother’s womb.
God shaped me before I was born.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ אַ֭תָּה קָנִ֣יתָ כִלְיֹתָ֑י תְּ֝סֻכֵּ֗נִי בְּבֶ֣טֶן אִמִּֽי׃

passages.text: I praise You, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Marvelous are Your works, and I know this very well.
passages.sermon:
God made me.
God made me in a fearful and wonderful way.
God’s works are marvelous.
I know this very well.
passages.original: אֽוֹדְךָ֗ עַ֤ל כִּ֥י נוֹרָא֗וֹת נִ֫פְלֵ֥יתִי נִפְלָאִ֥ים מַעֲשֶׂ֑יךָ וְ֝נַפְשִׁ֗י יֹדַ֥עַת מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
passages.sermon:
God knows everything about me.
God saw my body as it formed.
Nothing about my frame was hidden from God.
God made me in secret.
God wove me together in a hidden place.
God created me in the depths of the earth.
passages.original: לֹא־ נִכְחַ֥ד עָצְמִ֗י מִ֫מֶּ֥ךָּ אֲשֶׁר־ עֻשֵּׂ֥יתִי בַסֵּ֑תֶר רֻ֝קַּ֗מְתִּי בְּֽתַחְתִּיּ֥וֹת אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
passages.sermon:
God, You saw me before I was fully formed.
Your eyes looked at my unshaped body.
You wrote every day of my life in Your book.
You planned all my days before any of them began.
passages.original: גָּלְמִ֤י׀ רָ֘א֤וּ עֵינֶ֗יךָ וְעַֽל־ סִפְרְךָ֮ כֻּלָּ֪ם יִכָּ֫תֵ֥בוּ יָמִ֥ים יֻצָּ֑רוּ וְלֹא אֶחָ֣ד בָּהֶֽם׃

passages.text: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
passages.sermon:
God, You have many thoughts.
Your thoughts are precious to me.
Your thoughts are important.
Your thoughts are great in number.
Your thoughts are vast.
passages.original: וְלִ֗י מַה־ יָּקְר֣וּ רֵעֶ֣יךָ אֵ֑ל מֶ֥ה עָ֝צְמוּ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
passages.sermon:
God has many thoughts.
God’s thoughts are precious and vast.
If I try to count God’s thoughts, I cannot finish.
God’s thoughts are more than the grains of sand.
When I wake up, I am still with God.
God remains with me always.
passages.original: אֶ֭סְפְּרֵם מֵח֣וֹל יִרְבּ֑וּן הֱ֝קִיצֹ֗תִי וְעוֹדִ֥י עִמָּֽךְ׃

passages.text: O God, that You would slay the wicked— away from me, you bloodthirsty men— who speak of You deceitfully; Your enemies take Your name in vain.
passages.sermon:
God, You are holy and just.
I ask You to destroy the wicked.
Wicked people do evil.
Bloodthirsty men love violence.
Keep these violent men far from me.
These men speak about You with lies.
They use Your name for evil plans.
Your enemies use Your name in vain.
They do not honor You.
They act against Your will.
passages.original: אִם־ תִּקְטֹ֖ל אֱל֥וֹהַּ׀ רָשָׁ֑ע וְאַנְשֵׁ֥י דָ֝מִ֗ים ס֣וּרוּ מֶֽנִּי׃ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יֹ֭אמְרֻךָ לִמְזִמָּ֑ה נָשֻׂ֖א לַשָּׁ֣וְא עָרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker asks a question.
The speaker hates those who hate the LORD.
The speaker detests those who rise against the LORD.
passages.original: הֲלֽוֹא־ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ יְהוָ֥ה׀ אֶשְׂנָ֑א וּ֝בִתְקוֹמְמֶ֗יךָ אֶתְקוֹטָֽט׃

passages.text: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David speaks to God.
David hates those who hate God.
David hates them with complete hatred.
David counts them as his enemies.
passages.original: תַּכְלִ֣ית שִׂנְאָ֣ה שְׂנֵאתִ֑ים לְ֝אוֹיְבִ֗ים הָ֣יוּ לִֽי׃

passages.text: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David asks God to search him.
David asks God to know his heart.
David asks God to test him.
David asks God to know his thoughts.
passages.original: חָקְרֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל וְדַ֣ע לְבָבִ֑י בְּ֝חָנֵ֗נִי וְדַ֣ע שַׂרְעַפָּֽי׃

passages.text: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
passages.sermon:
God, look inside me.
See if there is any wrong way in me.
Show me if I am doing anything that offends you.
Guide me.
Lead me in the way that lasts forever.
Lead me in the way that is right and eternal.
passages.original: וּרְאֵ֗ה אִם־ דֶּֽרֶךְ־ עֹ֥צֶב בִּ֑י וּ֝נְחֵ֗נִי בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עוֹלָֽם׃
